title: Vivre, suivre, servir, rire et courir
summary: Use five short irregular present families without forcing them into one pattern.
objectives: Form all persons of vivre, suivre, rire, servir and courir.
Transfer each pattern to common derivatives without confusing singular stems.

sources.label: Public A2 index: topic-coverage reference only

sections.title: Similar sounds, different stems
paragraphs: A verb family groups a base verb and words built from it. Vivre means to live; suivre means to follow or take a course. Their singular forms end in -s, -s, -t, but their stems differ. Je suis can therefore mean 'I am' with être or 'I follow' with suivre; the rest of the sentence identifies the meaning.
points: Vivre: je vis, tu vis, il/elle/on vit, nous vivons, vous vivez, ils/elles vivent. Survivre follows the same pattern with sur-.
Suivre: je suis, tu suis, il/elle/on suit, nous suivons, vous suivez, ils/elles suivent. Poursuivre adds pour-.

examples.english: I am taking a training course.
examples.note: Une formation is the object of suivre.

mistakes.why: The plural subject requires suivent, not singular suit.

sections.title: Keep each family's full pattern
paragraphs: Servir drops v in the singular but keeps it in the plural; desservir follows it. Do not apply that rule to every verb ending in -vir: vivre above keeps v in vit. Rire keeps ri- even in nous rions; sourire adds sou-. Courir keeps cour- throughout its present forms; parcourir follows it.
points: Servir: je sers, tu sers, il/elle/on sert, nous servons, vous servez, ils/elles servent.
Rire: je ris, tu ris, il/elle/on rit, nous rions, vous riez, ils/elles rient. Sourire: je souris, tu souris, il/elle/on sourit, nous sourions, vous souriez, ils/elles sourient.
Courir: je cours, tu cours, il/elle/on court, nous courons, vous courez, ils/elles courent.

examples.english: She laughs and the children smile.

examples.french: Ils **courent** au parc ; nous **parcourons** le quartier à pied.
examples.english: They run in the park; we walk through the neighbourhood.
examples.note: Parcourir means to cover or travel through; it does not require running.

practice.explanation: The singular stem is vi- before -t.

practice.prompt: Present of suivre: Nous ___ les panneaux.
Present of servir: Tu ___ le thé.
Present of survivre: Ces plantes ___ au froid.
Present of poursuivre: Il ___ ses études.
Present of rire: Nous ___ de cette histoire.
Present of sourire: Vous ___ sur la photo.
Present of desservir: Ces trains ___ trois villages.
Present of parcourir: Je ___ dix kilomètres à vélo.
Present of suivre: Elle ___ un traitement.
practice.explanation: The treatment is what she follows.

practice.prompt: Present of rire: Les spectateurs ___ beaucoup.
Present of vivre: Vous ___ loin de votre travail.
Present of servir: Ce code ___ à ouvrir la porte.
Present of sourire: Le bébé ___ à sa sœur.
Correct the verb only: Nous courrons chaque matin. Use the present, not the future.
practice.explanation: Present courons has one r; future courrons has two.

production_task.prompt: Describe a normal morning in your neighbourhood, including where you live, transport or a course, and an activity.
production_task.model_answer: Je vis près d'un parc et je cours le matin. Le bus dessert mon centre de formation. Nous suivons un cours de cuisine et nous servons ensuite le repas.
production_task.translation: I live near a park and I run in the morning. The bus serves my training centre. We take a cooking class and then serve the meal.
